findings.issue: IEEE_INT rounding matrix incomplete: no negative ties and no non-tie IEEE_AWAY rows separating ties-to-away from directed rounding
findings.resolution: every ROUND mode over 2.5, -2.5, 3.5, -3.5 and 2.3, -2.3, 2.7, -2.7, with a separating row per mode pair

findings.issue: the invalid-conversion plan covered only a vague out-of-range value
findings.resolution: finite out-of-range, +inf, -inf, quiet and signaling NaN rows signal IEEE_INVALID, halting-safe, with no comparison of the processor-dependent result

findings.issue: IS_FINITE/IS_NAN/IS_NEGATIVE/IS_NORMAL truth tables were incomplete and IS_NEGATIVE inputs were pre-verified circularly
findings.resolution: full tables over +-0, +-subnormal, +-normal, +-inf, quiet and signaling NaN, inputs pre-verified with IEEE_CLASS
